# auth.login — POST /auth/login

Log in

Exchanges email and password for an access token and returns the user. Every login issues a new token; old tokens stay valid.

## Call
```ts
const res = await user.auth.login({ body: { email: "alice@example.com", password: "secret123" } })
res.assert(200)
```

## Input
```ts
{ body: LoginDto }
```

## Responses
```ts
200: TokenDto
401: ErrorDto // Wrong email or password.
```

## Types
```ts
type LoginDto = {
  /** Email the user registered with. */
  "email": string
  /** User password. */
  "password": string
}
type TokenDto = {
  /** Send it as `Authorization: Bearer <accessToken>`. */
  "accessToken": string
  /** The logged-in user. */
  "user": UserDto
}
type UserDto = {
  /** User id. */
  "id": number
  /** Email the user registered with. */
  "email": string
  /** Avatar URL. `null` until the user uploads an avatar. */
  "avatarUrl": string | null
}
type ErrorDto = {
  /** HTTP status code. */
  "statusCode": number
  /** Error message. Validation errors (400) return a list: one message per failed constraint. */
  "message": string | Array<string>
  /** HTTP status text, e.g. "Not Found". */
  "error"?: string
}
```
